svg.aria-label: npm run bench: Simulated. No model, no cost. npm run bench:live -- --provider glm: Agent: real model, real tokens. Needs ZAI_API_KEY or DEEPSEEK_API_KEY. npm run bench:publish: Publish the run to the bench-results branch. This rebuilds the site. Benchmark workflow: In GitHub Actions, run the Benchmark workflow by hand (Run workflow). It has no timer trigger
